title: The Mask We Wear
description: Every business owner, every father, every man has a version of themselves they show the world. What happens when you finally take it off?
showNotes:
We all have a public version — the confident business owner, the guy who's got it figured out. In this episode I talk about the cost of wearing that mask every day and what it took to start being honest with myself and the people around me.

**Key Topics:**
- The entrepreneur mask — why we pretend everything is fine
- How dishonesty with yourself compounds over time
- The first time I was truly honest about where I was
- Small steps toward authenticity that don't feel like jumping off a cliff
